strategy_catalog.name: Multi-level KV Outer Tiling - Usage Scenarios
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Implement a two-level KV sequence tiling scheme with s2OuterBlocks and s2BaseSize. When kvSeqLen is large, split it into s2OuterBlocks outer blocks of size s2BaseSize. Q can be loaded once at the start of each outer block and reused across all inner micro-tiles.

s2BaseSize.description: Outer KV block size in rows

conditions: L1 can hold Q chunk of size mBaseSize*dim
usage_scenarios.benefit: Q loaded once per outer block, reused across microNLoops inner tiles, reducing GM->L1 traffic by factor of microNLoops
Can cache larger Q chunk across inner tiles

usage_scenarios.reason: Outer tiling overhead exceeds benefit, keep single-level tiling

hardware_constraints.description: Large kvSeqLen benefits from Q reuse across inner tiles
hardware_constraints.impact: Reduces GM->L1 Q traffic from N_tiles to N_outer_blocks
